verdict.rationale: DeepInfra docs explicitly describe deploying dedicated instances to 'run your own fine-tuned LLM' on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and private endpoints (deepinfra-docs-8,9,18,33), covering custom weight serving. However, there is no explicit mention of LoRA adapter upload/serving specifically, nor detail on the actual weight-upload workflow/format requirements. Missing for 10: explicit LoRA adapter support, concrete upload/API steps for weights, independent hands-on confirmation of the deployment process.
